AppFunctionAppMetadata.appfn:description: PixelReceipt stores receipt drafts for human review. Use importReceiptForReview for user-provided TWD receipt fields and product rows. Use createReviewDraft only when the user wants an empty draft. These actions do not run an AI model, disclose the existing ledger, assign ownership, or confirm spending. Unknown fields must remain null. Never infer missing amounts. Retry imports using the same requestId and identical fields; use a new token for a new receipt. Users review and confirm in PixelReceipt.
